payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including BLEU scores and manual inspections of translations.

claims.text: The quality of the data is evaluated using sentence-level BLEU scores compared to human translations.
Translations with low scores are manually inspected and sent back to translators for correction.
The evaluation also considers model output variance across different speakers to assess stability.
A normalized quality score, $	extrm{BLEU}_{MS}$, is calculated to provide a more accurate measure of translation quality.
